## Lurker in Darkness (CR 12)

**XP** 19,200  
NE Huge outsider (extraplanar, evil)  
**Init** +9; **Senses** see in darkness; detect magic, Perception +22  
**Aura** aura of despair (30 ft., DC 21)  


**Offense**


**AC** 28, touch 14, flat-footed 22 (+5 Dex, +1 dodge, +14 natural, -2 size)  
**hp** 225 (15d10+75)  
**Fort** +13, **Ref** +10, **Will** +13  
**DR** 10/magic; Immune mind-affecting; **Resist** cold 15, electricity 15; **SR** 18  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft., climb 30 ft.  
**Melee** 2 tendrils +24 (4d8+10 plus feed on hopes and grab) or touch +24 (feed on hopes)  
**Special Attacks** constrict (4d8+10 plus feed on hopes), feed on hopes  
**Space/Reach** 15 ft./15 ft.  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 12th; concentration +16)  


Constant—detect magic, magic fang  

At will—deeper darkness, crushing despair (DC 16), unholy blight (DC 18)  

**3/day**-cowardice (DC 16), greater dispel magic, invisibility  

1/day—cone of cold (DC 19), greater crushing despair (DC 21), haste, hold monster (DC 19), plane shift (DC 21)  



**Statistics**


**Str** 28, **Dex** 16, **Con** 19, **Int** 16, **Wis** 19, **Cha** 19  
**Base Attack** +15; **CMB** +26; **CMD** 29 (can’t be tripped); +4 with grapple  
**Feats** Combat Reflexes, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Improved Grapple, Lightning Reflexes, Spring Attack, Weapon Focus (tendril), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Dodge and Mobility are one feat, Dodgility; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Improved Initiative, Toughness.*  
**Skills** Bluff +22, Climb +27, Escape Artist +18, Intimidate +27, Knowledge (arcana) +22, Knowledge (planes) +22, Perception +22, Sense Motive, +22, Spellcraft +13, Stealth +19, Swim +27  
**Languages** Common, Abyssal, Aklo; telepathy 100 ft.  
**SQ** shadowy form  


**Special Abilities**


**Aura of Despair (Su)** A lurker in darkness has an aura that dims the area and causes a sense of despair in those around them. This lowers the light level by 2 levels within 30 feet. This dimming is equivalent to a 3rd level spell for the purposes of superseding light spells. Additionally, anytime a creature enters the aura they must make a Will save (DC 21, the save DC is charisma-based) or have the despairing condition until they leave the aura and for 1d4 rounds thereafter. On a successful save, the creatures have the doubting condition. Once a creature has been affected by the aura, they are immune to its effects for 24 hours. This is a mind-affecting despair condition.  

**Feed on Hopes (Su)** A lurker in darkness feeds off of hopes and revels in inflicting feelings of hopelessness in their prey. With a touch attack or as part of their natural attacks, a lurker in the dark can increase the despair condition by one level and empower themselves. The target must make a Will save (DC 21, the save DC is charisma-based) or have their condition worsened. A creature not affected by a despair condition becomes doubting, a creature with the doubting condition becomes despairing and a creature with the despairing condition becomes hopeless. If the target is already subject to the hopeless condition, they must still make a Will save or have their life force sapped from them, see below. The increased condition lasts as long as the underlying effect.
